description: Photos chosen for the out-of-distribution set from the candidates of scripts/build_ood_set.py --discover, after looking at every candidate. Rule for near categories: the subject fills a large part of the frame, at most one photo per near-duplicate series, no people as the main subject. Far categories: any clear photo of the category. Every skipped candidate has a reason code.

reason_codes.dup: near-duplicate of a chosen photo or of another photo in the same series
reason_codes.subject: the category's subject is small, partly hidden or not the main subject
reason_codes.art: drawing, print, painting, diagram or composite
reason_codes.animal: an animal is the main subject
